Create and edit a mesh

A persistent handle: build it, then insert or remove points and constraint segments in place (vertex ids stay stable).

lari_new()
Create a mesh handle
lari_add_points() lari_add_segments() lari_remove_points() lari_remove_segments()
Edit a mesh

Refine

Delaunay refinement, step-by-step refinement, and the edge-length floor.

lari_refine()
Refine a mesh
lari_step()
Step the mesher
default_min_edge_length()
Default refinement edge-length floor

Output and inspection

The vertices / segments / triangles contract, mesh counts, and the one-row provenance report.

lari_tables() lari_vertices() lari_triangles() lari_segments() lari_depth()
Mesh tables
lari_counts()
Mesh counts

One-shot

Build and optionally refine in a single call.

lari_triangulate()
